title: Measuring and Understanding Brand Value in a Dynamic Model of Brand Management
authors: Ron N. Borkovsky; Avi Goldfarb B; Avery M. Haviv; Sridhar Moorthy
eligible_reason: Structural dynamic model of brand management (nested-logit IV first stage for brand equity; dynamic advertising model estimated via GAMS/MATLAB). No DiD.
design_notes: Data and Code/: preStage2.Rdata holds first-stage IV results; 'Stage 2 - Compute Expected Profits.R' and 'Bootstrap Second Stage.r' compute profit functions; Dynamic Files/'Main File- Estimation.m' estimates the dynamic model.
data_files_note: First Stage READ ME: 'The data used in the first stage is obscured to maintain confidentiality'; only first-stage estimates and derived matrices are shipped.
data_provenance_note: Raw sales data not shipped; intermediate estimates only.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract from data/frame/mksc.jsonl read. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
